questions.stem: 如今，無論到哪裡旅行，我們都能輕易找到少數幾個國際品牌所販售的相同商品。
questions.answer: These days, no matter where we travel, we can easily find identical products sold by just a few global brands.
accepted_answers: Nowadays, no matter where we go, we can easily find the same products sold by a handful of international brands.
Today, wherever we travel, it is easy for us to find identical products sold by only a few international brands.

patterns: 讓步：無論…（no matter where = wherever）
分詞片語後位修飾名詞（…所販售的商品＝products sold by …）

questions.stem: 面對全球化（globalization）的浪潮，許多小鎮開始推廣只有當地才有的傳統節慶和美食。
questions.answer: Faced with the tide of globalization, many small towns have begun to promote traditional festivals and foods that are not found anywhere else.
accepted_answers: Facing the wave of globalization, many small towns have started to promote traditional festivals and food that are unique to their area.
Faced with globalization, many small towns have started promoting traditional festivals and dishes that can only be found in their own areas.

patterns: 分詞構句（面對…：Faced with / Facing …）
關係代名詞限定子句（只有當地才有的＝that cannot be found anywhere else）

1.explanation_zh: 「無論到哪裡」用 no matter where＋S＋V（＝wherever），中文省略主詞，英文要補 we，語序是直述句。「少數幾個國際品牌所販售的商品」修飾語放在名詞後面：products sold by just a few global brands（sold 是被動分詞，等於 that are sold）。「相同商品」是 identical products 或 the same products。
evidence: 少數幾個國際品牌所販售的相同商品
1.strategy_zh: 先寫讓步子句 No matter where we travel，再寫主要子句 we can easily find＋名詞，最後把「…所販售的」變成後位修飾的過去分詞片語。
hints: 切成四段：無論到哪裡旅行／我們都能輕易找到／少數幾個國際品牌所販售的／相同商品
標的詞彙：travel（旅行）、find（找到）、sell（販售）、brand（品牌）、identical（相同的）
句型框架：No matter where + S + V, S + can + V + N + p.p. + by …

2.explanation_zh: 「面對…」放句首，用分詞構句 Faced with／Facing＋名詞，邏輯主詞是後面的「許多小鎮」。「浪潮」是比喻，寫 the tide／wave of globalization（單數）。「只有當地才有的」改成放在名詞後面的關係子句 that are not found anywhere else／that are unique to their area，節慶與美食是被找到的，用被動。「開始推廣」是已經出現的變化，用現在完成式 have begun to promote。
evidence: 只有當地才有的傳統節慶和美食
2.strategy_zh: 先寫主幹 many small towns have begun to promote＋名詞，把「只有當地才有的」改成 that 子句放在名詞後面，最後補句首的 Faced with …。
hints: 切成四段：面對全球化的浪潮／許多小鎮開始推廣／只有當地才有的／傳統節慶和美食
標的詞彙：town（小鎮）、promote（推廣）、traditional（傳統的）、festival（節慶）
句型框架：Faced with + N, S + have begun to VR + N + that + V …

Nowadays, no matter where we go, we can easily find the same products sold by a handful of international brands.
Today, wherever we travel, it is easy for us to find identical products sold by only a few international brands.

patterns.frame: No matter where + S + V, S + V … ; Wherever + S + V, …

accepted: no matter where we travel
no matter where we go
wherever we travel
wherever we go

common_errors.wrong: no matter where do we travel
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter where 後面用直述句語序。
中文沒寫主詞，英文要補上 we。

accepted: we can easily find
it is easy for us to find
we can easily buy

common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾動詞 find 要用副詞 easily。
這裡的「都」只是加強語氣，不必譯成 all；硬要加，位置是 we can all。

parts.zh: 少數幾個國際品牌所販售的
accepted: sold by just a few global brands
sold by a handful of international brands
sold by only a few international brands
sold by a few international brands
sold by a small number of international brands

common_errors.wrong: selling by just a few global brands
common_errors.right: sold by just a few global brands
common_errors.explanation_zh: 商品是「被」販售的，用過去分詞 sold；selling 是主動。

common_errors.wrong: which sold by just a few global brands
common_errors.right: sold by just a few global brands
common_errors.explanation_zh: 用關係代名詞就要有 be 動詞（which are sold）；不然直接用分詞 sold。

accepted: identical products
the same products

common_errors.explanation_zh: same 前面要加 the；或改用 identical。

traps.literal_error: No matter where travel, we can easily find identical products.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「無論到哪裡旅行」沒有主詞；英文的 no matter where 子句是完整子句，要補上主詞 we。

traps.zh: 少數幾個國際品牌所販售的相同商品
traps.literal_error: we can easily find just a few global brands sell identical products
traps.explanation_zh: 中文的修飾語放在名詞前面；英文要把被動分詞片語 sold by … 放到 products 後面，不能把「品牌販售」變成另一個子句硬塞進去。

bonus.text: Wherever we may travel these days, identical products sold by a few global brands are never hard to find.
bonus.explanation_zh: 以 Wherever … may … 表讓步，主要子句改用 are never hard to find（從來都不難找到）的否定說法，語氣更生動。

1.restructuring_zh: 「少數幾個國際品牌所販售的相同商品」中文修飾語放在名詞前，英文把被動分詞片語 sold by … 放到 products 後面。

common_errors.right: Faced with the tide of globalization,
common_errors.explanation_zh: 被動的 faced 後面要加 with。

many small towns have started to promote

common_errors.right: many small towns have begun to promote

common_errors.wrong: many small towns have begun to promotion
common_errors.right: many small towns have begun to promote
common_errors.explanation_zh: to 後面接原形動詞 promote；promotion 是名詞。

accepted: that are not found anywhere else
that are unique to their area
that cannot be found anywhere else
that can only be found in their own areas
that are found only in their area
that can only be found there

common_errors.right: that are not found anywhere else
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「只有當地才有的」不要逐字翻；寫成 are not found anywhere else 或 are unique to their area。

common_errors.wrong: that are not find anywhere else
common_errors.right: that are not found anywhere else
common_errors.explanation_zh: 節慶和美食是「被找到」的，要用被動 be found。

accepted: traditional festivals and foods
traditional festivals and food
traditional festivals and dishes

common_errors.explanation_zh: 泛指各種節慶用複數 festivals。
修飾名詞要用形容詞 traditional。

traps.explanation_zh: 「浪潮」是比喻，英文說 the tide／wave of globalization（單數）；寫成 big waves 或用所有格都不自然。

traps.zh: 只有當地才有的傳統節慶和美食
traps.literal_error: many small towns have begun to promote only-local traditional festivals and foods
traps.explanation_zh: 中文的修飾語「只有當地才有的」放在名詞前；英文要改成名詞後面的關係子句 that are not found anywhere else。

bonus.text: In the face of globalization, many small towns have begun to promote local festivals and dishes found nowhere else.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 In the face of …（面對）開頭，句尾用分詞片語 found nowhere else（別處都找不到的）取代關係子句，更精簡。

2.restructuring_zh: 「只有當地才有的傳統節慶和美食」修飾語放名詞後面，寫成關係子句 traditional festivals and foods that are not found anywhere else；「面對…浪潮」用分詞構句 Faced with the tide of globalization。

1.translation: Nowadays, no matter where we travel, we can easily find the same products sold by a few international brands.
1.explanation_zh: 「無論到哪裡」用 no matter where（也可寫 wherever）；「少數幾個國際品牌所販售的相同商品」用過去分詞片語後位修飾 the same products sold by a few international brands。

2.translation: Faced with the wave of globalization, many small towns have begun to promote traditional festivals and foods that can only be found locally.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對浪潮」用過去分詞構句 Faced with the wave of globalization；「開始推廣」用現在完成式 have begun to promote；「只有當地才有的」用限定關係子句 that can only be found locally；「美食」譯成 foods。

1.translation: Nowadays, no matter where we travel, we can easily find the same goods sold by just a few international brands.
1.explanation_zh: 「無論到哪裡」用 no matter where；「少數幾個國際品牌所販售的相同商品」用過去分詞片語 sold by just a few international brands 後置修飾 the same goods。

2.translation: Faced with the tide of globalization, many small towns have started to promote traditional festivals and local dishes that cannot be found anywhere else.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對……」用過去分詞片語 Faced with...；「全球化的浪潮」譯成 the tide of globalization；「只有當地才有的」用關係子句 that cannot be found anywhere else（也可用 unique to the area）；「開始推廣」用現在完成式 have started to promote。

issues_zh: 「相同商品」我寫 the same goods；第 4 部分 accepted 只有 identical products／the same products，「商品」譯成 goods 是很自然的寫法，建議補 the same goods。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義

status_reason: blind_solver:B 未通過：第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義；人工審核：第 1 句「相同商品」寫 the same goods 是自然譯法，第 4 部分只收 identical／the same products，accepted 太窄；另外第 2 部分把 we all can easily find 列為常見錯誤，we all can 雖不如 we can all 常見但不算錯，列為錯誤會誤扣分。
